summary: Every legal input has exactly four digit positions and a fixed colon, so there is no variable workload over which an honest runtime scaling trend can be measured.

replacement_checks.evidence: The remotely accepted implementation examines and possibly replaces each of the four digit positions a constant number of times, with no loop or recursion.
The certificate regression generates all 1,925 distinct patterns obtainable from valid times and compares the reference with enumeration of all 720 valid 12-hour times.
